note: DCInside 쿠키런 크럼블 gallery (projectcc) posts on Crumble Dungeon in the 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-07 window, read 2026-10-07 from evidence/r2026-10-07/02-dc/dc/<id>.md and their images (local only). posts.title_en: Thanks for the tip that gets Milk out early
posts.summary_en: After resetting power: dropped the buffers that cast at once, filled the power cutoff with dealers that stand and auto-attack like Dark Choco, and lowered Pomegranate's level; Milk now runs straight in. Previous limit 180G. The screenshot is mid-fight (3.24G at 50.9 s, 11.33G total power), not a result.
mechanics: A lower Pomegranate level gets Milk to the front sooner.
Stand-still dealers fill the 40 without dragging Milk.

posts.title_en: Take out the back line and Milk comes out at once
posts.summary_en: Removing back-line cookies brings Milk out at once. Replies: lowering Pomegranate to Lv.60 made Milk run forward immediately, confirmed by a second player; deleveled supports follow her; the placement is by power order.
mechanics: Pomegranate at Lv.60 makes Milk come out at once (two players).
Deployment slots follow the power order.

quotes.kr: 석류 레벨 60으로 낮췄더니 바로 달려오더라고

posts.summary_en: Perk comparison. One player found both the Skill Haste perk and the element-damage perk fine and Milk's arrival random either way. 전치: lower Brightseeker Skill Haste seems better; over 30+ runs each, Rapid Promotion gave a slightly higher score per power than Like A Family.

posts.title_en: The cookie screen shouldn't include the Rift buff
posts.summary_en: 전치: the cookie-selection screen's power includes the Dimensional Rift buff, which scrambles the dungeon's power order; a clean order now has to back out the Rift buff, and a new Rift step, research or breakthrough changes it again. Another player spent four keys to get the order right.
mechanics: The Rift buff counts in the displayed power that orders the dungeon's 40, so displayed order and deployed order can differ.

quotes.kr: 크던전 투력 서순 다 흐트러진다
quotes.en: It scrambles the dungeon's power order

quotes.kr: 이면버프 역산해야됨
quotes.en: You have to back out the Rift buff

posts.title_en: Rift stat inflation: the dungeon no longer deploys in order
posts.summary_en: Cookies no longer deploy in the order shown. Replies: lower-power cookies climb in the lineup screen, and gear with accuracy or focus shows Rift-inflated power, so equipping it can lower real deck power.
mechanics: Accuracy and focus lines show inflated power from the Rift.

quotes.kr: 명중이랑 집중 붙어있는템들이 이면 투력뻥 있어서
quotes.en: Gear with accuracy and focus has Rift-inflated power

posts.title_kr: 이면에서 명중템 투력 올라간다고 함부로 먹지마라..
posts.title_en: Don't equip accuracy gear just because the Rift shows more power
posts.summary_en: An accuracy item showed +100M power through the Rift buff; equipped, the deck's power fell 10M.
mechanics: Displayed power gains from the Rift buff can be false.

quotes.en: It said +100M so I equipped it; deck power dropped 10M

mechanics: Passion Pay targets the highest displayed ATK, without the captain's +10%.
